settings.title: Description
settings.content:
Lymphgem is a once-daily lymphatic support softgel. Each softgel combines four classic lymph herbs (cleavers, red clover, stillingia root and prickly ash bark) concentrated 20:1 for a 6,000mg herb equivalent, with 150mg Pycnogenol® French maritime pine bark, 60mg Centella asiatica TTFCA and 100mcg selenium.

Everything is suspended in MCT coconut oil inside a vegan softgel with no gelatin and no beeswax. 30 softgels per pouch.

settings.title: Why You Need Lymphgem
settings.content:
Your lymphatic system moves fluid through your body all day, but it has no pump of its own. Long hours sitting or standing, travel, hormones and age can leave you feeling puffy, heavy and swollen by the end of the day.

Lymphgem gives your body daily botanical support for healthy lymphatic flow and circulation, in one softgel that's easier to stick with than drops, teas or handfuls of capsules.*

settings.title: Recommended Use
settings.content:
Take 1 softgel daily with breakfast and a glass of water. For best results, take it every day for at least 60 days, alongside plenty of water and daily movement.

Talk to your doctor before use if you are pregnant or nursing, take medication (especially blood thinners) or have a medical condition.

settings.summary: Centella asiatica TTFCA for heavy, tired legs
settings.message: Centella's standardized triterpene fraction (TTFCA) has been studied for leg heaviness and swelling, including in passengers on long flights. A systematic review of the clinical trials found improvements in these signs and symptoms.
settings.sources:
Flight microangiopathy in medium- to long-distance flights: prevention of edema with TTFCA | Angiology, 2001
A systematic review of the efficacy of Centella asiatica for chronic venous insufficiency | Evid Based Complement Alternat Med, 2013
settings.highlights:
Leg Comfort
Travel Swelling
Centella Asiatica

settings.name: Dr. Priya Raman, ND
settings.message: Selenium is an essential trace mineral that powers the body's antioxidant enzymes. In one lymphology clinic, nearly half of patients were low in selenium, and a randomized trial linked selenium to less extracellular fluid. 100mcg a day covers the daily need.
settings.sources:
Selenium deficiency in lymphedema and lipedema | Nutrients, 2020
Sodium selenite alleviates breast cancer-related lymphedema | Nutrients, 2019

settings.name: Dr. Daniel Okafor, MD
settings.message: Cleavers (Galium aparine) has been the go-to lymphatic herb in European and American herbal medicine for centuries. Modern lab research has measured immune-modulating activity in its extracts. Lymphgem uses a 20:1 extract, so 100mg equals 2,000mg of the herb.
settings.sources:
Phytochemical profiles and in vitro immunomodulatory activity of ethanolic extracts from Galium aparine | Plants, 2019
Immuno-enhancing effects of Galium aparine L. | Nutrients, 2024

settings.name: Dr. Helena Brooks, MD
settings.message: Red clover is rich in isoflavones and has a long history as a cleansing herb. In a 2024 randomized placebo-controlled trial, red clover isoflavones improved cholesterol markers and menopausal symptom scores in women.
settings.sources: Isoflavones obtained from red clover improve both dyslipidemia and menopausal symptoms in menopausal women | Climacteric, 2024

settings.name: Dr. Tomás Rivera, DO
settings.summary: Prickly ash bark, the circulation herb
settings.message: Northern prickly ash bark was used by Native American and 19th-century physicians to warm the body and stimulate circulation. Lab analysis has identified the active coumarins and lignans in the bark. Lymphgem uses a 20:1 extract, equal to 1,300mg of bark.
settings.sources:
Cytotoxic coumarins and lignans from extracts of the northern prickly ash (Zanthoxylum americanum) | Phytotherapy Research, 2001
Antifungal constituents of northern prickly ash | Phytomedicine, 2005
settings.highlights:

Traditional Use

settings.question: What does Lymphgem do?
settings.answer: Lymphgem supports your body’s natural lymphatic flow and healthy circulation, so you feel lighter and less puffy as part of a daily routine.*

settings.question: Why a softgel instead of drops?
settings.answer: You get the same four classic lymph herbs without the dropper, the bitter taste or the guesswork. Every softgel is pre-measured, travels anywhere and adds 150mg Pycnogenol® and 60mg Centella, which most drops don’t have.

settings.question: Is Lymphgem vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. The softgel shell is vegan with no gelatin and no beeswax, and every ingredient sits in MCT coconut oil.

settings.question: Is Lymphgem safe to take every day?
settings.answer: Lymphgem is made for daily use. Talk to your doctor first if you are pregnant or nursing, take medication (especially blood thinners) or have a hormone-sensitive condition, since red clover contains plant estrogens. And if it’s not right for you, you’re covered by our 60-day money-back guarantee.
